summary: Tested the new interactive Migration Planner end-to-end after admin login. All planner data-testids render, step clicking swaps the detail heading/tasks and keeps a single active card, source/dest selectors flow into dynamic task text (GCP source -> stage01 task0, AWS dest -> stage03 blurb), task checkboxes toggle done state (li.done, chip x/4 done, green 'complete' when 4/4, progress bar % updates to 25% at 4/16), Prev disabled on stage01 and Next disabled on stage04, Prev/Next navigation works. Responsive check at 1920x900, 1024x800 and 390x844 shows zero elements overflowing beyond window.innerWidth. No console errors occur during planner interaction (only pre-login 401 from /api/auth/me, unrelated).

issues: Spec/review request expected a 2-column workflow grid at tablet width (1024x800); current CSS breakpoint is @media(max-width:900px), so at 1024 the layout stays in 4-column mode. No overflow, but to meet the stated tablet layout the planner breakpoint should be raised to ~1100px (or add a new 2-col breakpoint between 900-1100).

action_items: Optional: raise the .workflow 2-column breakpoint from max-width:900px to ~max-width:1100px so tablet (1024px) renders 2 columns as the review spec expected. Functional behavior is correct; this is a layout-density tweak.
critical_code_review_comments: Planner handles done-state via a key composed from stage id + task string. If a task string is edited the stored done flag becomes orphaned - acceptable given state is in-memory, but worth noting.
/api/auth/me returns 401 for unauthenticated visitors on the login page and prints to console - consider suppressing or treating 401 silently in the frontend to keep DevTools clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interactive Planner (/app/frontend/src/App.js function Planner, lines 41-73) is working: all required data-testids present (planner-hero, planner-progress, migration-workflow, planner-detail, planner-source-select, planner-dest-select, planner-step-{current,package,destination,switch}, planner-task-{stage}-{idx}, planner-prev-button, planner-next-button). CSS lives under 'MIGRATION PLANNER - interactive, responsive' section in App.css. Tablet (1024px) currently uses 4-col layout because planner media query breakpoint is 900px - only a minor density concern.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs blocking functionality. Minor layout-breakpoint observation only.
